paper.title: Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Knowledge-Intensive NLP Tasks

result.summary: 本文提出检索增强生成（RAG）模型，将预训练参数记忆（seq2seq 模型）与非参数记忆（Wikipedia 稠密向量索引，由预训练神经检索器访问）结合用于语言生成 [abstract]。作者提出 RAG-Sequence 与 RAG-Token 两种形式，分别在整个生成序列上使用同一检索段落和允许每个 token 使用不同段落 [S2.p2]。在多个知识密集型 NLP 任务上微调与评估后，模型在三个开放域 QA 任务上取得当时最优结果，超过参数化 seq2seq 模型和任务特定的检索-抽取架构 [abstract]。在语言生成任务上，RAG 生成的文本比纯参数化 seq2seq 基线更具体、多样且符合事实 [abstract]。作者还展示了非参数记忆可被替换以更新模型知识 [S1.p4]。

research_question.text: 论文关注预训练语言模型在知识密集型任务上的局限：它们虽能在参数中存储事实知识，但访问和精确操作知识的能力仍有限，性能落后于任务特定架构，且为其决策提供出处和更新世界知识仍是未解决问题 [abstract]。作者因此探索一种通用的检索增强生成微调方案，将预训练参数记忆与非参数记忆结合用于语言生成 [abstract]。

evidence.quote: However, their ability to access and precisely manipulate knowledge is still limited, and hence on knowledge-intensive tasks, their performance lags behind task-specific architectures.
Additionally, providing provenance for their decisions and updating their world knowledge remain open research problems.
We explore a general-purpose fine-tuning recipe for retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) — models which combine pre-trained parametric and non-parametric memory for language generation.

method.text: RAG 模型将参数记忆设为预训练 seq2seq 模型，非参数记忆设为 Wikipedia 的稠密向量索引，并通过预训练神经检索器访问 [abstract]。为端到端训练检索器与生成器，作者将检索到的文档视为隐变量，并提出两种对隐文档进行边缘化的模型 [S2.p2]。RAG-Sequence 使用同一文档预测每个目标 token，RAG-Token 则可基于不同文档预测每个目标 token [S2.p2]。

evidence.quote: We introduce RAG models where the parametric memory is a pre-trained seq2seq model and the non-parametric memory is a dense vector index of Wikipedia, accessed with a pre-trained neural retriever.
To train the retriever and generator end-to-end, we treat the retrieved document as a latent variable.
In one approach, RAG-Sequence, the model uses the same document to predict each target token.
The second approach, RAG-Token, can predict each target token based on a different document.

experiments.text: 开放域问答方面，作者在 Natural Questions、TriviaQA、WebQuestions 和 CuratedTrec 四个数据集上评估，使用与先前工作相同的训练/开发/测试划分并报告 Exact Match 分数；由于 CT 和 WQ 较小，作者按 DPR 做法用 NQ RAG 模型初始化 CT 和 WQ 模型 [S3.SS1.p1]。抽象问答方面，使用 MSMARCO NLG v2.1，仅使用问题与答案而不使用提供的段落，将其作为开放域抽象问答任务 [S3.SS2.p1]。生成任务方面，作者提出基于答案实体生成 Jeopardy 问题的开放域问题生成任务 [S3.SS3.p1]。

evidence.quote: We consider four popular open-domain QA datasets: Natural Questions (NQ), TriviaQA (TQA). WebQuestions (WQ) and CuratedTrec (CT).
We use the same train/dev/test splits as prior work and report Exact Match (EM) scores.
As CT and WQ are small, we follow DPR by initializing CT and WQ models with our NQ RAG model.
To test RAG’s natural language generation (NLG) in a knowledge-intensive setting, we use the MSMARCO NLG task v2.1.
We do not use the supplied passages, only the questions and answers, to treat MSMARCO as an open-domain abstractive QA task.
we propose the more demanding task of generating Jeopardy questions.

findings.text: RAG 模型在三个开放域 QA 任务上取得当时最优结果，超过参数化 seq2seq 模型和任务特定的检索-抽取架构 [abstract]。在 Jeopardy 问题生成上，RAG-Token 优于 RAG-Sequence，两者在 Q-BLEU-1 上均超过 BART [S4.SS3.p1]。基于 452 对 BART 与 RAG-Token 生成结果的人工评估显示，评估者认为 BART 比 RAG 更符合事实的仅占 7.1%，而 RAG 更符合事实的占 42.7%，两者都符合事实的占 17% [S4.SS3.p1]。作者还表明非参数记忆可被替换，从而在世界变化时更新模型知识 [S1.p4]。

evidence.quote: We fine-tune and evaluate our models on a wide range of knowledge-intensive NLP tasks and set the state of the art on three open domain QA tasks, outperforming parametric seq2seq models and task-specific retrieve-and-extract architectures.
Table 2 shows that RAG-Token performs better than RAG-Sequence on Jeopardy question generation, with both models outperforming BART on Q-BLEU-1.
Evaluators indicated that BART was more factual than RAG in only 7.1% of cases, while RAG was more factual in 42.7% of cases, and both RAG and BART were factual in a further 17% of cases
Finally, we demonstrate that the non-parametric memory can be replaced to update the models’ knowledge as the world changes.

limitations.text: 作者指出，MSMARCO 中有些问题若无法访问金标段落就无法以匹配参考答案的方式回答，因此不使用金标段落时性能会更低 [S3.SS2.p1]。作者还指出，MSMARCO 中有些问题仅靠 Wikipedia 无法回答 [S3.SS2.p1]。在 FEVER 事实核查上，作者的结果与使用强检索监督的当时最优流水线模型相差 4.3% 以内 [S1.p4]。

evidence.quote: MSMARCO has some questions that cannot be answered in a way that matches the reference answer without access to the gold passages
so performance will be lower without using gold passages.
We also note that some MSMARCO questions cannot be answered using Wikipedia alone.
For FEVER fact verification, we achieve results within 4.3% of state-of-the-art pipeline models which use strong retrieval supervision.
